notes: Mid-market KM SaaS that powers internal knowledge search for enterprise customers. Primary objective: ship a reranking layer to improve search relevance for their help center and in-app knowledge surfaces. Current pipeline: candidate retrieval via Elastic -> offline scoring + lightweight neural reranker. Team wants a managed reranking endpoint (offline scoring / batch scoring + low-latency synchronous rerank for UI). Initially evaluating Redwood hosted API to speed POC, then will evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC networking for enterprise customers. Key asks: per-request rerank endpoint with batch/offline scoring support, predictable 95th/99th latency SLOs, token-level cost estimates, and tooling to run A/B evals against the canonical eval sets. Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for key management, audit logs, and data residency controls for EU customers. Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget but willing to commit for reserved capacity if unit economics and SLOs meet bar. Quote from ML lead: "Need a reranker endpoint we can trust for 10k qps spikes during product launches — and an easy way to replay evals offline."
